transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Uh... just having some issues at work, I guess. With, you know, staying focused. 

Like, I'll start a safety briefing or a plan review... try really hard to pay attention. But within a few minutes, my mind is just off on three other job problems. I end up missing things I know I should have caught. So... yeah. Figured I should come in.
How long have you been having trouble staying focused at work?

It's been... bad for a while now. Maybe a little over two years? Two years and a couple of months. 

Things shifted at work back then. The schedule changed, got a lot more chaotic. That's when it really started messing with my job. Before that, I don't know, I got by. But since then... yeah. About two years.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety at work?
I mean... I don't really know. Not really, I guess. I'm on my feet a lot anyway, moving around the site. So... it's hard to say.
Do you often interrupt others or blurt out answers at work?

Yeah, I guess so. Sometimes. I just... I cut people off, I suppose. 

Usually, I think I already know where they're going with a question, so I just jump in. Answer it. But... then sometimes I realize I missed the actual point they were trying to make. Because I answered too fast. So... yeah. That happens.
Do you have trouble organizing your tasks or managing your time effectively at work?

Yeah, I do. It's... it's a problem. 

My truck is a wreck. Desk is the same. Even the notes on my phone are just... a mess. It's hard when everything hits at once, you know? RFIs, inspections, budget stuff, guys on the crew having issues. I just... I don't know what to tackle first. So I kind of bounce between them. And then... well, everything just ends up running late.
Do you have trouble staying focused or getting organized at home, or is it mainly at work?

It's... both, I guess. 

At work, it's gotten bad. I've missed some follow-ups, and... the site coordination hasn't been great. My boss actually pulled me aside about it. Said it was a formal concern. 

And at home... yeah. My wife is just... she's tired of it. I tell her I'll handle something, and then I don't. She has to keep reminding me. So... it's everywhere, really.
How is your relationship with your wife, has it been affected by your difficulties with focus and organization?

Yeah, like I... like I just said. It's not great. She's just really worn down from it. Having to constantly remind me about things I told her I'd handle... it takes a toll on us. And with everything going on at work—like I mentioned, getting that formal warning over the missed follow-ups and the site coordination... it's just bad everywhere right now. I don't really want to get too deep into the marriage stuff, but... yeah. It's definitely affected.
Have you experienced significant symptoms of inattention, such as difficulty sustaining focus during tasks, before the changes at work about two years ago?

Yeah. It's... it's not a new thing. Goes way back. 

Even in elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents about it. Said I couldn't stay in my seat... talked out of turn. I was always losing my homework, or... just rushing through directions before I really understood what I was supposed to do. So... yeah. Way before two years ago.
Did you have a lot of energy or feel restless when you were a kid?
Yeah, I guess so. I mean, I already said I couldn't stay in my seat. Just... always moving around, I suppose.
Have you ever been fired or had significant problems at work or school because of your difficulty with focus, organization, or impulsivity?

I mean... I kinda already went over this. Yes. Like I said earlier, the site coordination being a mess and missing those follow-ups... it got me a formal warning from my boss. They're definitely concerned about it. And... at home, I already told you, my wife is just worn down from constantly reminding me to do things I promised I'd handle. So... yeah. It's causing problems.
Have you felt like your difficulties with focus and organization have caused you a lot of distress or stress beyond the issues at work and with your wife?
I mean... not really. Not beyond that. Just... work and home. That's enough stress, isn't it?
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're not at work?
I don't know. I haven't really paid attention to it. When I'm off the clock, I just... I don't really notice, I guess.
Did you have any of these focus or behavior issues when you were a teenager?

Yeah. Longer than that, really. I mean... even back in elementary school, teachers were already telling my parents about it. Said I couldn't stay in my seat... talked out of turn. Always losing my homework. Or I'd just... rush through directions before I actually understood what I was supposed to do. So... yeah. It's been a thing for a while.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still, like when you're watching TV or eating a meal?
I'm not really sure. Like I said, I don't pay much attention to that kind of thing. When I eat, I just eat and get up. I don't really sit around long enough to notice, I guess.
Were you more active or restless than your peers when you were a child?
Hard to say. I mean... I was just a kid. I didn't really pay attention to how much the other guys were running around compared to me. I just know what the teachers said.
Have you experienced significant symptoms of inattention or hyperactivity-impulsivity as an adult, outside of work-related situations?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... it's definitely bleeding into other stuff. At home, my wife is... she's pretty worn down. Says she always has to remind me about things I promised I'd take care of. And, uh... work's not much better. I've missed some follow-ups, and... my site coordination hasn't been great. It actually got to the point where my boss brought it up. Had a formal talk about it. So... yeah. It's an issue.
Have your difficulties with focus, organization, or impulsivity caused problems in your relationships with friends or affected your ability to do things you enjoy?

Not really. I mean... I don't have a lot of time for hobbies anyway. Mostly just work and home. And with friends, uh... we just grab a beer or watch a game sometimes. It's not really a situation where they'd notice if I'm organized or whatever. So... no, I guess not.
Do you often feel an internal restlessness or an inability to relax when you're not actively engaged in something?

I don't know. I mean... I'm usually pretty busy. I don't really have a lot of downtime to just sit around and see how I feel about it. When I'm off work, there's usually something that needs fixing around the house, or... I just try to keep moving. So, no, I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Do you often interrupt others or have difficulty waiting for your turn in social situations outside of work?

Uh... I don't know about social situations. Like I said, I mostly just work. But... I guess it happens on the job. I'll walk up on two subcontractors talking, or... someone trying to get through paperwork, and I just jump right in. Just start making my point before I'm even asked. It, uh... it rubs people the wrong way sometimes. But I don't know about outside of work.
Do you still have difficulty waiting for your turn or interrupting others in your daily life?

Yeah... waiting is tough. Like... if I'm on hold, or down at the permit office... or even just in a line somewhere. It just... it drives me nuts. I'm always checking my watch, shifting around... just trying not to push my way to the front. I don't know why, it's just... hard to stand there.
